source_role: records which residual-row fields are actually supported by the current publication-anchor evidence
source_label: Field coverage assessment for Vanadium, Nb3Sn, and Nb3Ge publication anchors

materials.assessment_basis: Secondary-host abstract-style text capture now supports Tc and Theta scope, but direct primary raw-page capture has not yet been archived.

fields.note: A secondary-host abstract mirror states Tc=5.03 K, which is stronger than title-only scope but still below primary raw-page evidence.
A secondary-host abstract mirror states Theta=338+-5 K, which gives field-level support but still needs primary raw-page confirmation.
An open full-text Eliashberg study explicitly reports lambda = 0.91 for vanadium, but compatibility with the benchmark row still needs review.
An open full-text Eliashberg study gives explicit vanadium-specific mu_star values, but convention compatibility still needs review before benchmark-row use.

materials.assessment_basis: APS abstract explicitly states the superconducting transition temperature near 18 K.

fields.note: APS abstract explicitly reports the superconducting transition temperature of Nb3Sn at 18 K.

The current anchor does not demonstrate a Coulomb pseudopotential row.
